structured_output.summary:
Chimney stacks A/B (x10..12) and B/C (x18..20), z18..19, from y5 to y28 with deepslate band at y26, stone-slab cap and two lit campfires at each top; flues at x=11 and x=19 stay air.
Four fireboxes at x=10, 12, 18, 20 (y3..4, z18..19) with campfire and stone_bricks floor, and upside-down brick_stairs lintels at y=5 facing into each room.
parts/chimneys.mjs writes 232 blocks, no refused writes, no off-palette blocks; make.sh gives a whole build.nbt; elements.md items for the stacks and fireplaces ticked.
left: The roofs part has not landed in this copy (roof.json absent), so the stack's pass through the mansard and the roof-surface clearance are not checked; re-check once roofs are merged.
Hearth lintels are brick_stairs at y=5, the top of the stack's face cells, so the stack's brick side at those two cells is the lintel; no separate lintel beam.
The two campfire tops are signal_fire false per plan; a hay_block under them would give a signal fire, but the plan does not ask for one.
The campfires at the firebox backs (y=3) are lit light sources in the room air: the room designers must keep furniture off the campfire cells.
The check reports 16 orphan smooth_sandstone blocks on the bay and shell (not this part's).

waste.what: Found out by build-and-read that fireboxes and stacks collide at y=5: hearth lintels were refused until I reordered the calls. The conflict is visible from the spec alone.
